desc: Enter the P365 X Macro, the most capable version to date. Now, they have enhanced that platform further with the Tyrant CNC P365 X Macro Grip Module. Constructed from their ultra-rugged and high-quality carbon and glass-filled polymer composite, this full-length grip module upgrades the factory frame with better ergonomics, an enlarged dovetail, a high grip undercut, and customized variable depth texturing, giving you the control and compatibility that serious shooters demand.
